requirements.title: ACM Problem-Solving Platform
requirements.description: A website designed to help users solve ACM-style programming problems and improve their coding skills.

features.name: Problem Library
features.description: A comprehensive library of ACM-style programming problems categorized by difficulty and topic.

features.name: Code Submission and Evaluation
features.description: Allows users to submit code solutions and receive automated feedback on correctness and performance.

features.name: User Profiles and Progress Tracking
features.description: Enables users to create profiles, track their progress, and view their problem-solving history.

features.name: Leaderboard
features.description: Displays rankings of users based on their problem-solving performance and achievements.

features.name: Hints and Explanations
features.description: Provides hints and detailed explanations for problems to help users learn and improve.

requirements.target_users: Students, competitive programmers, and individuals preparing for coding competitions.
requirements.data_requirements: Requires storage for user profiles, problem data, code submissions, and performance metrics.

tasks.name: Design Problem Library UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for browsing and searching programming problems.

tasks.name: Implement Problem Library Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to store and retrieve programming problems.

tasks.name: Set Up Problem Database
tasks.description: Design and create the database schema for storing programming problems.

tasks.name: Develop Code Submission UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for users to submit their code solutions.

tasks.name: Implement Code Evaluation System
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to evaluate submitted code against test cases.

tasks.name: Design User Profile UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for user profiles and progress tracking.

tasks.name: Implement User Profile Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage user profiles and track progress.

tasks.name: Set Up User Database
tasks.description: Design and create the database schema for storing user information and progress.

tasks.name: Develop Leaderboard UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying the leaderboard.

tasks.name: Implement Leaderboard Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to calculate and display leaderboard rankings.

tasks.name: Add Hints and Explanations UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying hints and explanations for problems.

tasks.name: Implement Hints and Explanations Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage and serve hints and explanations for problems.

tasks.name: Test Problem Library Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the problem library works as expected.

tasks.name: Test Code Submission and Evaluation
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure code submission and evaluation works correctly.

tasks.name: Test User Profiles and Progress Tracking
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure user profiles and progress tracking are accurate.

tasks.name: Test Leaderboard Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the leaderboard displays correct rankings.

tasks.name: Test Hints and Explanations
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure hints and explanations are displayed correctly.

tasks.name: Deploy ACM Problem-Solving Platform
tasks.description: Deploy the platform to a production environment.

T1.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface with search, filter, and categorization options for problems.
T1.notes: Ensure responsive design for both desktop and mobile.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle problem retrieval, creation, and updates.
T2.notes: Focus on scalability and secure data handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a relational database schema to store problem details, tags, and metadata.
T3.notes: Optimize for quick search and retrieval.

T4.implementation_approach: Create an intuitive UI for users to write, test, and submit code solutions.
T4.notes: Include syntax highlighting and error feedback.

T5.implementation_approach: Build a backend system to compile, execute, and evaluate code submissions securely.
T5.notes: Use containerization to isolate code execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a profile page to display user details, progress, and achievements.
T6.notes: Incorporate a clean and visually appealing layout.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage user data, progress tracking, and achievements.
T7.notes: Ensure proper authentication and data privacy.

T8.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store user information, progress, and activity logs.

T9.implementation_approach: Design a leaderboard UI to display top users based on various metrics.

T10.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to calculate and serve leaderboard rankings dynamically.

T11.implementation_approach: Create a UI to display hints and explanations for problems in an accessible format.
T11.notes: Allow toggling hints to avoid spoilers.

T12.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage and serve hints and explanations for problems.
T12.notes: Ensure hints are tied to specific problem IDs.

T13.implementation_approach: Perform end-to-end testing of the problem library's UI and backend functionality.
T13.notes: Test for edge cases and performance under load.

T14.implementation_approach: Test the code submission and evaluation system for accuracy, security, and performance.
T14.notes: Simulate various programming languages and edge cases.

T15.implementation_approach: Verify user profile features, including progress tracking and achievement updates.
T15.notes: Test with different user scenarios and data loads.

T16.implementation_approach: Test the leaderboard functionality for accuracy and responsiveness.
T16.notes: Ensure rankings update correctly in real-time.

T17.implementation_approach: Validate the hints and explanations system for proper display and relevance.
T17.notes: Check for consistency across different problems.

T18.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform to a cloud environment with proper CI/CD pipelines.
T18.notes: Ensure monitoring and logging are in place for post-deployment support.
